first_event.definition: value at first frozen lifecycle event among T2/P0 minus exit now
limitations: still a terminal commitment to that event
T2 is a lifecycle label, not necessarily an economically executable exit objective
first_event.name: DELTA_V_EVENT

fixed_horizon.definition: executable value after prospectively chosen H minus exit-now value
fixed_horizon.name: DELTA_V_H
fixed_horizon.status: definition only; not evaluated or selected

sequential_policy.definition: value under a prospectively frozen future causal policy minus exit now
sequential_policy.name: DELTA_V_POLICY
sequential_policy.status: not identifiable until policy is defined

terminal.definition: hold to frozen P0 minus exit now
terminal.name: DELTA_V_P0
